name: zinput_keyboard_reset_transition_state
description: zInput::Keyboard_ResetTransitionState drains pending keyboard input, updates transient modifier state, clears key transition states, and resets modifier state.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zInput keyboard source-cluster pass.
Binary Ninja notes an embedded modifier-class byte table immediately after the function return; source uses the recovered kKeyboardModifierClasses table instead of a raw code-address reference.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x46f450 validates the ready guard, GetDeviceData call, DIERR_INPUTLOST reacquire path, modifier-key updates, modified dwData flags for non-modifier keys, the 0x7de-entry dispatch-state clear loop, and final g_zInput_KbdModifierState reset.
Native smokes verify reset-via-resume clears the target dispatch entry and modifier state, and the input-lost path reacquires the keyboard device.
